date.note: arXiv v1 submission date; the journal version is Phys. Rev. D 92, 092003 (2015).

name: A Revised Experimental Upper Limit on the Electric Dipole Moment of the Neutron

significance.quote: which may be interpreted as a slightly revised upper limit on the magnitude of the EDM of
significance.value: 90% CL upper limit 3.0 x 10^-26 e cm (95% CL 3.6 x 10^-26 e cm)

summary.plain: The ILL collaboration re-analysed its 1998-2002 data and obtained d_n = -0.21 ± 1.82 x 10^-26 electron charge times centimetre, a slightly revised upper limit of 3.0 x 10^-26 at 90 per cent confidence.
summary.technical: Re-analysis including gravity-depolarisation effects, an improved neutron spectrum calculation and conservative systematics: d_n = -0.21 ± 1.82 x 10^-26 e cm, |d_n| < 3.0 x 10^-26 e cm (90% CL) or 3.6 x 10^-26 e cm (95% CL).

title: A Revised Experimental Upper Limit on the Electric Dipole Moment of the Neutron
why_it_matters: The abstract calls it the first detailed and comprehensive analysis of the experimental results that set the current world sensitivity limit on the neutron EDM.
